usage: As a noun, 整修 (zing2 sau1) refers to the act or process of repairing something.
As a verb, it means to repair or fix something that is broken or damaged.
整修 can be used for buildings, appliances, vehicles, or other items that need maintenance.
When using 整修 as a verb, it often appears before the object being repaired.
It is commonly used in everyday conversations related to home maintenance and repairs.
